IncidentBot: [INCIDENT #2026-11] production inference errors detected on eu-west-1 (paging: dmitri.petrov) :rotating_light:
IncidentBot: Severity: P2 — errors affecting a subset of requests (e.g., long-tail timeouts). Auto-paged oncall: @Dmitri Petrov. Root at 1755554321.

Dmitri Petrov: I'm on it — seeing elevated 5xx from runtime shards serving model 'redwood-*'. Traces show request queueing spikes around 15:12 UTC.

Jordan Lee: tagging in — I can look at autoscaler/queue metrics, possible KV cache pressure. Any recent deploys?

Maya Gonzalez: no deploys in the last 24h from my side. Last config change was small routing tweak yesterday.

Dmitri Petrov: quick mitigation: throttled low-priority routes and enabled emergency burst capacity. Error rate dropped ~60% after 3m. Still seeing errors for long-prefix requests.

Amy Chen: CS heads-up: a few customers on Dedicated in eu-west-1 reported failures in the last 20m. I haven't sent customer comms yet — want to confirm scope.

Samir Patel: can you confirm which customers saw errors? I'm pulling from support queue.

Dmitri Petrov: logs show increased errors for requests >1024 tokens and for embeddings batches >8 in flight on a shard set. Affected subset: hosted + dedicated shared routing in eu-west-1.

Jordan Lee: hypothesis: KV cache eviction thrashing with large sequence lengths. Mitigation path: reduce max_batch_tokens for those routes and pin hot models to separate shard pool.

Maya Gonzalez: pushing a config to reduce max_batch_tokens to 512 for the affected model groups. Rolling now — ETA 8m.

IncidentBot: Deploy to runtime-config succeeded at 1755554642.

Dmitri Petrov: after config change error rate normalized, latency steady. Marking incident as mitigated at 1755554730.

Amy Chen: thanks — CS: request from legal/ops: can we prepare a concise customer note + suggested status page entry? Need to include timeline, scope, customer impact, mitigation, and next steps (RCA + preventative actions).

Priya Nair: draft below for status page and customer email. Please edit / 👍 before I send.

Priya Nair: STATUS PAGE DRAFT:
- Incident start: 2026-06-18 15:12 UTC
- Impact: A subset of inference requests in eu-west-1 experienced elevated errors and latency. Affected workloads: long-sequence text generation (>1024 tokens) and large embedding batches. This impacted both hosted API and customers routing through shared dedicated pools.
- Mitigation: We temporarily reduced batching limits and increased burst capacity to reduce queueing. Error rates returned to baseline by 15:35 UTC.
- Customer impact: Some requests failed or timed out during the window. Customers with heavy long-sequence usage may have seen higher error rates; normal operations resumed after mitigation.
- Next steps: Full RCA and preventative actions to be published within 5 business days.

Amy Chen: good. Suggest adding a sentence about SLA credits: "We will assess eligibility for SLA credits for impacted customers and follow up directly."

Priya Nair: updated.

Samir Patel: CUSTOMER EMAIL DRAFT (short):
Hi <Customer Team>,

We wanted to let you know about an incident in our eu-west-1 inference cluster on 18 June 2026 between ~15:12–15:35 UTC that may have affected some of your inference requests, particularly very long generations or large embedding batches. We mitigated the issue by reducing batching limits and adding burst capacity; normal service resumed at ~15:35 UTC.

We will provide a full RCA and any compensatory SLA details within five business days. If you saw errors during that window and would like help investigating specific request IDs, please reply to this message and include sample request IDs or timestamps.

Apologies for the disruption — we're taking steps to prevent recurrence.

Best,
The Redwood Inference Team

Maya Gonzalez: tiny edit: change "between ~15:12–15:35 UTC" to exact times we recorded: 15:12:01 UTC -> 15:35:30 UTC.

Priya Nair: done.

Amy Chen: CS ask: who owns sending the customer email? I can triage high-severity/dedicated customers manually but prefer a single canonical send from CS so we have tracking.

Samir Patel: I can send to directly impacted customers once we finalize list. Amy, can you confirm the customer list?

Dmitri Petrov: attached query results in logs: shard_ids [s-21, s-22] had >1% error spike. I've shared logs in the incident thread (link). Use those to map customer routing.

Amy Chen: pulling mapping now — will send list in 10m. Also need approval for proposed SLA credit template.

Jordan Lee: for the RCA note: short summary to include in customer follow-up — root cause: cache eviction + oversized batching causing queue pressure and request prioritization inversion; immediate fix: reduced max_batch_tokens for high-cost routes + emergency burst allocation. Preventative items:
- separate hot-model shards for long-sequence workloads
- circuit-breaker on per-route queue depth
- telemetry alert for KV cache miss-rate correlated with queue latency
- adjust default batching config for models with >512 tokens typical usage

Maya Gonzalez: will own the "separate hot-model shards" rollout plan. Target: rolling changes in eu-west-1 in 3 weeks.

Dmitri Petrov: I'll add a queue-depth circuit-breaker PR and telemetry alert. ETA 7 business days.

Priya Nair: RN follow-up plan for CS: publish short status page now, send targeted customer emails to impacted accounts within 1 hour of this thread, and send full RCA + compensatory SLA info within 5 business days.

Amy Chen: thumbs up. Priya: please add a small internal note template for PMs/Executives who ask — one-paragraph summary + link to status page and ETA for full RCA.

Priya Nair: INTERNAL EXEC NOTE TEMPLATE:
We experienced elevated inference errors in eu-west-1 on 18 June 2026 (15:12:01–15:35:30 UTC) affecting long-sequence generation and large embedding batches. Mitigation actions were taken and service returned to baseline. We are preparing a detailed RCA and preventative actions; expected delivery: 5 business days. Customer outreach to impacted accounts is underway.

Samir Patel: Amy — list coming in 6m, I can queue sends.

Amy Chen: thanks everyone. Closing loop: incident marked mitigated and CS communications sent. Will reopen thread if the RCA uncovers broader impact. :white_check_mark:

Dmitri Petrov: filing post-incident ticket and will link to this thread + logs for RCA.

IncidentBot: Incident #2026-11 changed status to mitigated at 1755554730.

Amy Chen: last ask — please add any exact customer-facing timestamps or sample request IDs to the ticket before the RCA doc goes live.

Jordan Lee: adding logs and sample request IDs now.

Priya Nair: message sent to impacted customers at 1755554982 (tracking: CS-SEND-2026-06-18-01).

Amy Chen: thanks — marking this thread resolved from CS side at 1755554999.

[End of thread]
